map.轴承载荷寿命选型 使用指南: Bearing Load Life Selection User Guide
map.输入基本额定动载荷 C、当量动载荷 P、转速 n，计算 L10 基本额定寿命（百: Enter the basic dynamic load rating C, equivalent dynamic load P and speed n to compute the L10 basic rating life (millions of revolutions and hours)
map.L10=(C/P)^p 百万转（球 p=3、滚子 p=10/3）。: L10 = (C/P)^p million revolutions (p = 3 for ball bearings, 10/3 for rollers).
map.：C=60 kN、P=10 kN、n=1500 rpm：L10=(60/10)^: : C = 60 kN, P = 10 kN, n = 1500 rpm: L10 = (60/10)^3 = 216 million revolutions; L10h = 1e6 × 216/(60 × 1500) = 2400 h. If P = 15 kN: L10 = (4)^3 = 64 million revolutions, L10h = 711 h, so a 50% load increase cuts life by about 70%.
map.车削/铣削切削速度与进给量: Turning and milling cutting speed and feed
map.同一批轴承 90% 可达或超越的寿命（百万转），即 10% 在此之前失效，是额定: The life that 90% of a batch of bearings reaches or exceeds (in millions of revolutions), meaning 10% fail before it; it is a rating, not a guarantee.
map.当量动载荷 P 怎么来？: Where does the equivalent dynamic load P come from?
map.由实际径向/轴向载荷与载荷系数合成 X·Fr+Y·Fa，再乘冲击系数，详见轴承样: From actual radial/axial loads and load factors compose X·Fr + Y·Fa, then multiply by the shock factor; see the bearing catalogue for details.
